title: Static 'players only channel 1 rune at the start of their Channel Phase' has no effect
expected: Card def in /root/src/tcg/tcg-engines/packages/riftbound-cards/src/data/sets/ven.json for ven-036-166 (Sandstone Chimera) has "abilities": [], "parseSuccess": false — no static ability registered; no .ts override exists. Engine channel phase in riftbound-engine/src/game-definition/flow/riftbound-flow.ts:402-415 hardcodes baseChannelCount = 2 (3 for second player's first turn) with no hook consulting battlefield statics, so no channel-count-limit mechanic exists.
observed: player-2 rune pool went 0->3 and player-1 rune pool went 2->4 (runeDeck 10->8) — normal 2-rune channel unaffected. Registered def for ven-036-166 has no abilities at all (set JSON parseSuccess:false, abilities:[]) and the engine has no channel-count-limit mechanic
